en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a broad, empty road leading toward a cluster of buildings surrounded by open fields and leafless trees. The buildings appear to be a mix of residential and industrial structures. There is a low fence running alongside the road. The lower left corner of the postcard contains the text 'Nyköping Sunlightområdet', and a number '23735' appears on the lower right.
